components.label: Wash drum
components.description: Holds the wash load and remaining water.

components.label: Sump channel
components.description: Guides water from the drum toward the filter and pump.

components.label: Pump filter
components.description: A user-accessible fictional filter that can collect debris.

components.label: Drain pump
components.description: A sealed fictional pump shown for identification only.

components.label: Drain hose
components.description: Carries drained water away from the washer.

components.label: Control module
components.description: Professional-only internal electronics; no repair steps are provided.

checks.label: Make the washer safe
checks.instruction: Cancel the cycle, disconnect power, and wait for all movement to stop.
checks.why: The next checks involve standing near retained water and an access door.
checks.stop: Stop if you notice smoke, a burning smell, hot water, or an active leak near power.

results.label: There is a burning smell or smoke
The water or cabinet feels hot

checks.label: Check the drain hose
checks.instruction: Look behind the washer without moving or lifting it. Is the visible hose sharply bent, pinched, or disconnected?
checks.why: A visible hose restriction can stop water before an internal part is involved.
checks.stop: Do not reach behind, pull out, tilt, or lift the washer. Choose unsafe to reach instead.

results.label: The hose is kinked or pinched
The hose is disconnected or damaged

checks.label: Check the pump filter
checks.instruction: With power disconnected, place towels and a shallow tray by the lower access door. Open only the user access door and inspect the filter.
checks.why: The fictional pump filter is the most likely remaining restriction after a clear hose.
checks.stop: Water may release. Stop if the water is hot, the access is damaged, or anything requires a tool or internal panel removal.

results.label: The filter is blocked by debris
The filter or access door is damaged
